purpose: Find products of two cube dimensions that already have an evidence foothold and a nearby assessed open obligation, while keeping unassessed cells and unseeded gaps distinct.

method.projection_rule: Fix one key on each of two axes and inspect all six keys on the remaining axis.
method.seed_strength: 4 * local-result cells + 3 * literature-result cells + 1 * pieces-only cells
method.bridge_score: If seed_strength is zero, 0; otherwise 2 * min(seed_strength, open_demand) + 2 * pieces-only cells + priority-gap cells.
method.why_minimum: The minimum rewards a balance between reusable evidence and named open work; one cannot compensate for the complete absence of the other.
method.ranking_boundary: The integer score is a transparent triage heuristic over current classifications. It is not probability, theorem strength, expected scientific value, or evidence that a bridge exists.
method.not_mapped_rule: NOT_MAPPED contributes no points and is never converted into a gap or recommendation.

classification_rules.NEAR_TERM_LOCAL_BRIDGE: At least one local-result cell and at least one pieces-only or priority-gap cell occur along the scanned axis.
classification_rules.NEAR_TERM_LITERATURE_BRIDGE: No local-result cell, but at least one literature-result cell and at least one pieces-only or priority-gap cell occur along the scanned axis.
classification_rules.PIECES_ONLY_FRONTIER: No local or literature result is present, but at least one pieces-only cell supplies a partial foothold.
classification_rules.UNSEEDED_IMPORTANT_GAP: At least one priority gap is assessed, but the pair has no local, literature, or pieces-only foothold.
classification_rules.NO_FRONTIER: No assessed open cell occurs along the scanned axis.
